name: Zure, Knight of Dark World
ability: The name of this illustrious knight is known by all residents of Dark World. He never oppresses the commoners.

name: V-Tiger Jet
ability: This ace fighter is unbeatable in a dogfight. It combines with other monsters to launch an array of encircling attacks.

name: Blade Skater
ability: An image of beauty on the ice, this gorgeous warrior rips her opponents into pieces with her stylish Accel Slicer attack.

name: Queen's Knight
ability: This knight catches her opponents off guard, dominating them with swift yet graceful attacks.

name: Jack's Knight
ability: A strong master swordsman. His loyalty is to justice, his duty to protect the weak.

name: King's Knight
ability: When this card is Normal Summoned while you control "Queen's Knight": You can Special Summon 1 "Jack's Knight" from your Deck.

name: Elemental HERO Bladedge
ability: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Elemental HERO Wildheart
ability: This card is unaffected by Trap effects.

name: Reborn Zombie
ability: While you have no cards in your hand and this card is in Attack Position, it cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Chthonian Soldier
ability: When this card is destroyed by an opponent's attacking monster and sent to the Graveyard, the Battle Damage you took from this battle is also inflicted to your opponent.

name: W-Wing Catapult
ability: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "V-Tiger Jet" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 400 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

name: Infernal Incinerator
ability: This card can only be Normal Summoned or Set by discarding all other card(s) in your hand and Tributing 1 card you control with 2000 or more ATK. This card gains 200 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. This card loses 500 ATK for each other monster you control.

name: Hydrogeddon
ability: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Hydrogeddon" from your Deck.

name: Oxygeddon
ability: If this card is destroyed by battle with a Pyro monster and sent to the GY: Each player takes 800 damage.

name: Water Dragon
ability: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Bonding - H2O". The ATK of FIRE monsters and Pyro monsters on the field becomes 0. When this card is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can target 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon" in your GY; Special Summon them.

name: Etoile Cyber
ability: If this card attacks your opponent directly, it gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only.

name: B.E.S. Tetran
ability: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 counter on this card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Nanobreaker
ability: If this card attacks a face-up Level 3 or lower monster, destroy the monster immediately with this card's effect without applying damage calculation.

name: Rapid-Fire Magician
ability: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent each time you activate a Normal Spell Card.

name: Beiige, Vanguard of Dark World
ability: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Special Summon it from the Graveyard.

name: Broww, Huntsman of Dark World
ability: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Draw 1 card, plus another card if this card was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect.

name: Brron, Mad King of Dark World
ability: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can discard 1 card.

name: Sillva, Warlord of Dark World
ability: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Special Summon it from the Graveyard, then, if this card was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, your opponent returns exactly 2 cards from their hand to the bottom of their Deck, in any order.

name: Goldd, Wu-Lord of Dark World
ability: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: If it was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, you can target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; Special Summon this card from the Graveyard, then destroy those targets (if any).

name: Scarr, Scout of Dark World
ability: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 Level 4 or lower "Dark World" monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Familiar-Possessed - Aussa
ability: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Aussa the Earth Charmer" and 1 face-up EARTH monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

name: Familiar-Possessed - Eria
ability: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Eria the Water Charmer" and 1 face-up WATER monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

name: Familiar-Possessed - Hiita
ability: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Hiita the Fire Charmer" and 1 face-up FIRE monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

name: Familiar-Possessed - Wynn
ability: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Wynn the Wind Charmer" and 1 face-up WIND monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

name: VW-Tiger Catapult
ability:
"V-Tiger Jet" + "W-Wing Catapult"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) You can discard 1 card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position. (Flip Effects are not activated.)

name: VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon
ability:
"VW-Tiger Catapult" + "XYZ-Dragon Cannon"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish that target. When this card declares an attack on an opponent's monster: You can target the attack target; change that attack target's battle position. (Flip Effects are not activated.)

name: Cyber Blader
ability:
"Etoile Cyber" + "Blade Skater"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. While your opponent controls only 1 monster, this card cannot be destroyed by battle. While your opponent controls only 2 monsters, double this card's ATK. While your opponent controls only 3 monsters, negate the effects of your opponent's Spell, Trap, and Effect Monster Cards.

name: Elemental HERO Rampart Blaster
ability:
"Elemental HERO Clayman" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position, but only if your opponent controls no monsters, and if it does, this card's ATK is halved during damage calculation only.

name: Elemental HERO Tempest
ability:
"Elemental HERO Avian" + "Elemental HERO Sparkman" + "Elemental HERO Bubbleman"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can send 1 other card you control to the Graveyard to target 1 monster you control; while this card is face-up on the field, that monster cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Elemental HERO Wildedge
ability:
"Elemental HERO Wildheart" + "Elemental HERO Bladedge"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card can attack every monster your opponent controls (one attack on each monster per Battle Phase).

name: Elemental HERO Shining Flare Wingman
ability:
"Elemental HERO Flame Wingman" + "Elemental HERO Sparkman"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 300 ATK for each "Elemental HERO" card in your Graveyard. When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

name: Pot of Avarice
ability: Target 5 monsters in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

name: Dark World Lightning
ability: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy that target, then discard 1 card.

name: Level Modulation
ability: Your opponent draws 2 cards. Special Summon 1 "LV" monster from your Graveyard, ignoring the Summoning conditions. The monster that was Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack, nor activate or apply its effect this turn.

name: Ojamagic
ability: If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: Add 1 each of "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Ojamuscle
ability:
(This card is always treated as a "Ojama" card.)
Select 1 face-up "Ojama King". Destroy all "Ojama" monsters on the field, except the selected "Ojama King". It gains 1000 ATK for each monster destroyed this way.

name: Feather Shot
ability: Target 1 face-up "Elemental HERO Avian" you control; during this turn, that target can attack a number of times equal to the number of monsters you control when this card resolves, but cannot attack directly, and other monsters you control cannot attack this turn.

name: Bonding - H2O
ability: Tribute 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon"; Special Summon 1 "Water Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

name: Chthonian Alliance
ability: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK for each other face-up monster on the field that has the same name it does.

name: Armed Changer
ability: Send 1 Equip Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard to activate this card. If the equipped monster destroys a monster by battle, the controller of this Equip Card can add 1 monster with ATK equal to or less than the equipped monster from their Graveyard to their hand.

name: Branch!
ability: When a Fusion Monster(s) on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 of the Fusion Materials in your Graveyard that was used for its Fusion Summon; Special Summon it.

name: Boss Rush
ability: You cannot Normal Summon or Set. During the End Phase of the turn that a "B.E.S." monster or a "Big Core" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "B.E.S." monster or 1 "Big Core" from your Deck.

name: Gateway to Dark World
ability: Target 1 "Dark World" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

name: Hero Barrier
ability: Negate 1 attack from an opponent's monster. You must control a face-up "Elemental HERO" monster to resolve this effect.

name: Chthonian Blast
ability: When a face-up monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy the 1 face-up monster on the field that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied), and if you do, inflict damage to both players equal to half of that monster's ATK.

name: The Forces of Darkness
ability: Target 2 "Dark World" monsters in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

name: Dark Deal
ability: When your opponent activates a Normal Spell Card: Pay 1000 Life Points; the effect of that Normal Spell Card becomes "Your opponent discards 1 random card".

name: Simultaneous Loss
ability: Each player sends the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Weed Out
ability: Pay 500 Life Points. Destroy all face-up Attack Position Level 3 monsters.

name: The League of Uniform Nomenclature
ability: Select 1 face-up Level 2 or lower Normal Monster you control to activate this card. Special Summon as many cards as possible from your Deck with the same name as the selected monster.

name: Roll Out!
ability: Target 1 Union monster in your Graveyard; equip that target to a monster you control that would be an appropriate target for that Union monster's effect.

name: Chthonian Polymer
ability: Activate only when your opponent Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster. Tribute 1 monster to take control of that Fusion Monster.

name: Feather Wind
ability: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated while you control a face-up "Elemental HERO Avian": Negate the activation and destroy it.

name: Non-Fusion Area
ability: Neither player can Fusion Summon.

name: Level Limit - Area A
ability: Change all face-up Level 3 or lower monsters to Attack Position.
